0022600006.text: The 76ers, now 1-0 after a road win, are 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East as they host the Cleveland Cavaliers, who open their season in this game. Philadelphia lost all four meetings with Cleveland in 2025-26, most recently 115-101 in Cleveland on March 9, and no games have been played yet between the teams in 2026-27. Out for Philadelphia are Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (back), and Tacko Fall (hip), while Dean Wade (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; for Cleveland, Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back) is out, and Jarrett Allen (knee) is a game-time decision, with Khalifa Diop (knee) and Sam Merrill also listed as day-to-day.
